summary_1line: After Bhishma finishes instructing, he dismisses Yudhishthira to rule and perform sacrifices, promising to die when the sun turns northward.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma lies on a bed of arrows while the Pandavas, Krishna, and assembled kings sit silently around him like painted figures.
The aged Bhishma blesses Yudhishthira and tells him to return to the city while the gathered sages and warriors listen.
